content.statement: The current returns_policy_v2 explicitly states a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, matching the claimed 30-day window.
content.plan: Extracted the current policy window from policy_docs (returns_policy_v2: 30 days), compared it with the claimed 30 days and the stale base_retrieval/base_judge_reference value (14 days), computed the 16-day difference and order eligibility at 10 days; a two-sample t-test was not computable because no n/mean/sd fields were provided.

evidence.test: deterministic policy-window comparison; two-sample t-test not computable
evidence.note: No two-group mean/sd data are present, so inferential significance testing is not applicable; direct policy comparison supports the claim.
